author: Lytei
body:
Dear Avicus staff and faculty, 

  While I was eating my doritos, preferably like a dorito ranch boy, I was in the midst of playing Avicus with my north american ping. The ip is avic.us if you care to join. I was doing the normal routine, bow spamming the pros, getting relentless combos on noobs, getting reported for being a douche and also ninja bridging. One of the very key factors of ninja bridging is shifting, as some of you may know it requires a set of skills with timing and agility. If you fail you fall either on one of the platforms of the map, however I occasionally fall into the void. Now we're getting into the deep misfortunate event that has occurred on this merciful evening. Since the Avicus staff and faculty added in the command known as /leave, I decided to use it when I fell into the void this evening, i did it cause i was not hit or shot off by faze clan members from across the map. That is what I interpreted "combat logging" to be, if you're hit, and do /leave or something you have combat logged. I didn't know there was such a thing as "void logging", but of course I know that now so I'll abide by the rules. The one thing I haven't done was apologize, so here I go. Oh I'm ever so sorry how could I have made the grevious error of logging off in the void after no one hit me. Sorry Avicus hope you urban me this evening cause I have no life. Thank you.

Sincerely, 
Dorito Ranch Boy AKA Lytei AKA MLG Void Logger 


P.S. : #VOIDLOGGINGMATTERS
